entries.name: OpenAI PRM800K
entries.notes: Registered as DISCOVERY_GRAPH_EVIDENCE. Its five discovery dimensions -- progress, valid-but-useless, dead end, alternative branch, attempt outcome -- are the ones reports/representation_search/DISCOVERY_REPRESENTATION_ANALYSIS.md measured and found that NO representation in the search space can express, because CanonicalMathState carries none of them. That is its whole value here: it names what the formal corpus structurally lacks. A Lean trace records only steps that were kept, so it contains no negative examples at all, while 25.3% of PRM800K's rated continuations are dead ends and 10.1% are valid-but-not-progressing. Never treat -1/0/+1 as Lean validity; the two live in different columns permanently.
